encodingDesc.p: Printed small capitals transcribed in uppercase; ordinary line-wrap hyphenation joined explicitly; lexical hyphens, spelling, punctuation, brackets and printed footnote pointers retained. Raw digital HTML/XML, scan crops and source bytes remain recoverable. Comparisons may fold case and ae/æ; original source readings are retained without such folding.

normalization.p: Sentence-case presentation is an editorial layer, not a replacement transcription. Each choice retains the exact accepted 1856 text in orig and a case-only display in reg. Proper names, ligatures, punctuation, spelling, source pointers and Roman labels are preserved; common nouns are lowercased. Compiled-index CSS selects reg only, without altering other witnesses.

revisionDesc.change: Authorized human browser-review correction: one provenance note immediately below the index title; reversible sentence-case readings and left-aligned presentation. Original 1856 readings and existing structural identities remain intact.

div.head: Whiston’s chapter headings (compiled index)
div.note: Compiled from the chapter headings printed in the Auburn and Rochester edition of Whiston's translation (Alden & Beardsley, 1856). The arrangement as an index is editorial, not an original printed table of contents.

choice.orig: CONTAINING THE INTERVAL OF FORTY YEARS.
choice.reg: Containing the interval of forty years.

choice.orig: FROM THE DEATH OF SAUL TO THE DEATH OF DAVID.
choice.reg: From the death of Saul to the death of David.

choice.orig: HOW DAVID REIGNED OVER ONE TRIBE AT HEBRON, WHILE THE SON OF SAUL REIGNED OVER THE REST OF THE MULTITUDE; AND HOW, IN THE CIVIL WAR WHICH THEN AROSE, ASAHEL AND ABNER WERE SLAIN.
choice.reg: How David reigned over one tribe at Hebron, while the son of Saul reigned over the rest of the multitude; and how, in the civil war which then arose, Asahel and Abner were slain.

choice.orig: THAT UPON THE SLAUGHTER OF ISHBOSHETH, BY THE TREACHERY OF HIS FRIENDS, DAVID RECEIVED THE WHOLE KINGDOM.
choice.reg: That upon the slaughter of Ishbosheth, by the treachery of his friends, David received the whole kingdom.

choice.orig: HOW DAVID LAID SEIGE TO JERUSALEM; AND WHEN HE HAD TAKEN THE CITY, HE CAST THE CANAANITES OUT OF IT, AND BROUGHT IN THE JEWS TO INHABIT THEREIN.
choice.reg: How David laid seige to Jerusalem; and when he had taken the city, he cast the Canaanites out of it, and brought in the Jews to inhabit therein.

choice.orig: THAT WHEN DAVID HAD CONQUERED THE PHILISTINES, WHO MADE WAR AGAINST HIM AT JERUSALEM, HE REMOVED THE ARK TO JERUSALEM, AND HAD A MIND TO BUILD A TEMPLE.
choice.reg: That when David had conquered the Philistines, who made war against him at Jerusalem, he removed the ark to Jerusalem, and had a mind to build a temple.

choice.orig: HOW DAVID BROUGHT UNDER THE PHILISTINES, AND THE MOABITES, AND THE KINGS OF SOPHENE, AND OF DAMASCUS, AND OF THE SYRIANS, AS ALSO THE IDUMEANS, IN WAR; AND HOW HE MADE A LEAGUE WITH THE KING OF HAMATH; AND WAS MINDFUL OF THE FRIENDSHIP THAT JONATHAN, THE SON OF SAUL, HAD BORNE TO HIM.
choice.reg: How David brought under the Philistines, and the Moabites, and the kings of Sophene, and of Damascus, and of the Syrians, as also the Idumeans, in war; and how he made a league with the king of Hamath; and was mindful of the friendship that Jonathan, the son of Saul, had borne to him.

choice.orig: HOW THE WAR WAS WAGED AGAINST THE AMMONITES, AND HAPPILY CONCLUDED.
choice.reg: How the war was waged against the Ammonites, and happily concluded.

choice.orig: HOW DAVID FELL IN LOVE WITH BATHSHEBA, AND SLEW HER HUSBAND URIAH, FOR WHICH HE IS REPROVED BY NATHAN.
choice.reg: How David fell in love with Bathsheba, and slew her husband Uriah, for which he is reproved by Nathan.

choice.orig: HOW ABSALOM MURDERED AMNON, WHO HAD FORCED HIS OWN SISTER; AND HOW HE WAS BANISHED, AND AFTERWARDS RECALLED BY DAVID.
choice.reg: How Absalom murdered Amnon, who had forced his own sister; and how he was banished, and afterwards recalled by David.

choice.orig: CONCERNING THE INSURRECTION OF ABSALOM AGAINST DAVID; AND CONCERNING AHITHOPHEL AND HUSHAI; AND CONCERNING ZIBA AND SHIMEI; AND HOW AHITHOPHEL HANGED HIMSELF.
choice.reg: Concerning the insurrection of Absalom against David; and concerning Ahithophel and Hushai; and concerning Ziba and Shimei; and how Ahithophel hanged himself.

choice.orig: HOW, WHEN ABSALOM WAS BEATEN, HE WAS CAUGHT IN A TREE BY HIS HAIR, AND WAS SLAIN.
choice.reg: How, when Absalom was beaten, he was caught in a tree by his hair, and was slain.

choice.orig: HOW DAVID, WHEN HE HAD RECOVERED HIS KINGDOM, WAS RECONCILED TO SHIMEI, AND TO ZIBA; AND SHOWED A GREAT AFFECTION TO BARZILLAI: AND HOW, UPON THE RISE OF A SEDITION, HE MADE AMASA CAPTAIN OF HIS HOST, IN ORDER TO PURSUE SHEBA; WHICH AMASA WAS SLAIN BY JOAB.
choice.reg: How David, when he had recovered his kingdom, was reconciled to Shimei, and to Ziba; and showed a great affection to Barzillai: and how, upon the rise of a sedition, he made Amasa captain of his host, in order to pursue Sheba; which Amasa was slain by Joab.

choice.orig: HOW THE HEBREWS WERE DELIVERED FROM A FAMINE WHEN THE GIBEONITES HAD CAUSED PUNISHMENT TO BE INFLICTED FOR THOSE OF THEM THAT HAD BEEN SLAIN: AS ALSO, WHAT GREAT ACTIONS WERE PERFORMED AGAINST THE PHILISTINES BY DAVID, AND THE MEN OF VALOUR ABOUT HIM.
choice.reg: How the Hebrews were delivered from a famine when the Gibeonites had caused punishment to be inflicted for those of them that had been slain: as also, what great actions were performed against the Philistines by David, and the men of valour about him.

choice.orig: THAT WHEN DAVID HAD NUMBERED THE PEOPLE, THEY WERE PUNISHED; AND HOW THE DIVINE COMPASSION RESTRAINED THAT PUNISHMENT.
choice.reg: That when David had numbered the people, they were punished; and how the divine compassion restrained that punishment.

choice.orig: THAT DAVID MADE GREAT PREPARATIONS FOR THE HOUSE OF GOD; AND THAT UPON ADONIJAH'S ATTEMPT TO GAIN THE KINGDOM, HE APPOINTED SOLOMON TO REIGN.
choice.reg: That David made great preparations for the house of God; and that upon Adonijah's attempt to gain the kingdom, he appointed Solomon to reign.

choice.orig: WHAT CHARGE DAVID GAVE TO HIS SON SOLOMON AT THE APPROACH OF HIS DEATH; AND HOW MANY THINGS HE LEFT HIM FOR THE BUILDING OF THE TEMPLE.
choice.reg: What charge David gave to his son Solomon at the approach of his death; and how many things he left him for the building of the temple.
